chapter: Radio, Jazz Record and Blue Note (Reel 2)
title: Losing the radio show to La Guardia
summary: Mayor La Guardia heard the show twice and the program was ended. Hodes would not answer thirty letters a day.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: What - why did you lose it? (synagogue La Guardia)

I lost it because La had heard me again. The second time he heard it, there was nothing for me to do. He always went on the air before me. I followed all the symphony music, all the fire alarms that he chased and all that. He was a great one for chasing fires in New York. And all the things that he would have to tell New York, -- WNYC

was New York's own station. And everything he would have to do would be before me at 1:30. But on occasion, there would be some reason for him to -- and so the radio would be on in the room where he was. And the second time this was on, there was no explaining that I wasn't commercial and (inaudible).

And so, there went the program and there was no -- I couldn't change. I wasn't going to sit down and answer 30 letters or more a day. The kids were just -- I kept a lot of them, they were just writing and what was I -- this is that record that you called their number out and I want to get it and I missed it. Or, I enjoyed your program. They called for an answer, and I just wasn't going to do it.
So I just -- I blew it.
You would give it out on the air.
Yes, I would give it out on the air, which is the way it should be done.
